messages:
omar_sales: Morning team - customer sent back a contract redline overnight. Key asks: MFN (broad), 12 month price protection, and a $0.012/token cap for any public promotion. Their purchasing team is pushing hard; they want POC next week.

viv_dealdesk: Broad MFN + 12 months = operational risk. We should push to limit MFN to "comparable commercial customers" and exclude short promos. If they insist on 12-month hold require a prepaid commit.

nina_legal: I'll draft counterlanguage: MFN applies only to pricing for substantially similar committed services and excludes sales promotions < $50k. Price protection limited to customers with prepaid commitments. Also carve out marketplace and reseller offers.

kevin_ps: POC technical note: their load pattern is spiky; this could create usage overage exposure. Request true-up and that MFN ties to committed units not just the fact of a published price.

alexa_se: Quick margin check: list = $0.02/token. With a 25% discount on a $200k commit = $0.015/token. A $0.012 promo cap would make it unprofitable on large volumes. Need to signal that promo caps below committed-discounted price are not acceptable.

omar_sales: Can we offer a hosted commit solution instead? They don't want Dedicated.

viv_dealdesk: Yes 1f44d propose tiers: $75k / $150k / $300k with escalating discounts. If commit < $150k, price protection = 90 days. If >= $150k, up to 12 months.

nina_legal: I'll include language that MFN is limited to customers within the same package and committed band, excludes transient promos (<$50k), and does not apply to beta or partner-funded promotions. Also add explicit no-retro refunds on past promos.

kevin_ps: Also propose a POC true-up clause: if POC volumes exceed forecast by >30% we reserve rights to re-evaluate billing terms or apply overage rates.

alexa_se: Will prepare a hosted-commit template snippet for Luke to share.

omar_sales: Thanks everyone - I'll hold off on POC scheduling until we have a verbal on commit bands.
